decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-75ddba51-7fff-6c48-01f8-ecd379192027"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">The proposed extension, by reason of its size, bulk and height on the boundary, would result in a loss of light and outlook to the adjoining occupiers of No. 82 Nightingale Road. As such, the proposal is contrary to policy D6 (Housing quality and standards) of the London Plan (2021), policy LP2 (Development and Amenity) of the Hackney Local Plan (2020), and Hackney's Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2025).</span></span></p>

<p>The proposed ground floor extension, by reason of its excessive size, bulk and scale, would be an unsympathetic, overly prominent and obtrusive form of development, failing to respect the character and appearance of the host dwelling and the wider terrace, where such proposals are an uncharacteristic feature. As such, the proposal is contrary to policies D3 (Optimising site capacity through a design-led approach) and D4 (Delivering good design) of the London Plan (2021), and policies LP1 (Design Quality and Local Character) and LP17 (Housing Design) of the Hackney Local Plan (2020), and Hackney's Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2025).</p><div class="modal-header " style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);"><button type="button" class="close" data-dismiss="modal"><span class="sr-only">Clos<span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400;">The proposed ground floor extension, by reason of its inappropriate design and excessive scale&nbsp; would be an unsympathetic, overly-prominent and visually intrusive form of development, failing to respect the character and appearance of the hosting dwelling and the wider terrace, where such proposals are an uncharacteristic feature. As such, the proposal is contrary to Policies D3 (Optimising site capacity through a design-led approach) of the London Plan (2021), LP1 (Design Quality and Local Character) of the Hackney Local Plan (LP33), and the Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2009)</span></span></button></div>
